Nunito (The Nunito Project Authors), SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL.txt).
https://github.com/googlefonts/nunito

The front end's font (the game library and the overlay), compiled into the
app (cmake/embed.cmake). Nunito-Regular.ttf and Nunito-Bold.ttf are static
instances (weights 400 and 700) of fonts/variable/Nunito[wght].ttf from
commit 8c6a9bb9732545b9ed53f29ec5e1ab0ff53c4e6f (version 3.602; sha256
bb55a5ca5c2042335b3991af27c4d0705d0ef41cac6164ac737fd8f2a1e85207), made with
scripts/nunito-instances.py (fontTools: instanced, subset to Latin,
Latin-1, Latin Extended-A, Cyrillic and punctuation, unhinted). The font
has no Reserved Font Name; these are modified versions under the OFL.
